title: RNA Library Preparation Protocol
author: Dakota Betz
materials: Carefully remove and discard the ethanol.

Amplify the library using the following thermocycling profile: A B C D 1 Step Temp. (°C) Duration Cycles 2 Initial denaturation 98 45 sec 1 3 Denaturation 98 15 sec **see table below 4 Annealing* 60 30 sec **see table below 5 Extension 72 30 sec **see table below 6 Final Extension 72 1 min 1 7 HOLD 4 (infinite) 1 *Optimization of the annealing temperature may be required for non- standard (i.e., other than Illumina TruSeq®) adapter/primer combinations. **See table below for recommended cycle numbers. Recommended library amplification cycles: A B 1 Quantity of starting material Number of cycles 2 50 – 100 ng 13 – 16 3 101 – 250 ng 11 – 14 4 251 – 500 ng 9 – 12 5 501 – 1000 ng 7 – 10
Proceed immediately to Library Amplification Cleanup .

steps.title: Equilibrate Reagents
steps.instruction: Equilibrate mRNA Capture Beads, mRNA Bead Binding Buffer, mRNA Bead Wash Buffer, Fragment, Prime and Elute Buffer (2X), KAPA Pure Beads, and PEG/NaCl Solution to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare and Wash mRNA Capture Beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend mRNA Capture Beads by gentle pipetting or low-to-medium speed vortexing (avoid foaming). Transfer 52.5 µL (50 μL + 5% excess) of beads per library into a tube; up to 1260 μL (24 libraries) can be washed in one tube.

substeps.instruction: Place tube on a magnet and incubate at room temperature until clear.
Discard supernatant and replace with 52.5 µL (per library) of mRNA Bead Binding Buffer.
Remove from magnet, resuspend beads (avoid foaming), and place back on magnet until clear.
Discard supernatant and replace with 52.5 µL (per library) of mRNA Bead Binding Buffer.

steps.title: Capture mRNA
steps.instruction: Distribute 50 μL of resuspended mRNA Capture Beads into individual tubes or wells per RNA sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 μL of RNA sample (in RNase-free water) to each tube and mix by gentle pipetting.
Perform 1st mRNA capture in a thermocycler: 65°C for 2 min, then cool at 20°C for 5 min.
Place on magnet until clear and discard supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 200 μL of mRNA Bead Wash Buffer, place on magnet until clear, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 50 μL of RNase-free water.
Perform 2nd mRNA capture in a thermocycler: 70°C for 2 min, then cool at 20°C for 5 min.
Add 50 μL of Bead Binding Buffer, mix by gentle pipetting, and incubate at 20°C for 5 min.
Place on magnet until clear and discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 200 μL of mRNA Bead Wash Buffer, place on magnet until clear, and discard all supernatant.

steps.title: Fragment, Prime, and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Prepare Fragment, Prime and Elute Buffer (1X) by mixing 11 µL RNase-free water and 11 µL Fragment, Prime and Elute Buffer (2X) per sample at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads from the capture step in 22 μL of the prepared 1X buffer (can be stored at 4°C for ≤24 hrs; do not freeze).
Run fragmentation/priming in a thermocycler based on desired insert size: 100-200 bp (8 min at 94°C), 200-300 bp (6 min at 94°C), or 300-400 bp (6 min at 85°C).
Immediately place on a magnet until clear (do not allow sample to cool before magnet placement).
Carefully transfer 20 μL of the supernatant to a separate tube and place on ice.

steps.title: Perform 1st Strand Synthesis
steps.instruction: On ice, assemble the reaction by mixing 20 μL of eluted RNA with 10 μL of 1st strand synthesis master mix (containing 11 µL 1st SSB and 1 µL KAPA Script per sample + 20% excess).

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by gentle pipetting.
Incubate: 25°C for 10 min (primer extension), 42°C for 15 min (1st strand synthesis), 70°C for 15 min (enzyme inactivation), then hold at 4°C.
Place on ice.

steps.title: Perform 2nd Strand Synthesis and A-tailing
steps.instruction: On ice, mix 30 μL of 1st strand synthesis product with 30 μL of 2nd strand synthesis and A-tailing master mix (containing 31 µL 2nd Strand Marking Buffer and 2 µL Enzyme Mix per sample + 10% excess).

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by gentle pipetting.
Incubate: 16°C for 30 min (2nd strand synthesis), then 62°C for 10 min (A-tailing), then hold at 4°C.
Place on ice.

steps.title: Ligate Adapters
steps.instruction: Dilute adapter stocks based on starting material: 1.5 μM for 50–499 ng or 7 μM for 500–1000 ng.

substeps.instruction: On ice, mix 60 μL of 2nd strand synthesis product, 45 μL of adapter ligation master mix (40 µL Ligation Buffer + 10 µL DNA Ligase per sample + 10% excess), and 5 μL of diluted adapter stock.
Mix by pipetting and incubate at 20°C for 15 min.

steps.title: First Post-ligation Cleanup (0.63X)
steps.instruction: Combine 110 μL of adapter-ligated DNA with 70 μL of KAPA Pure Beads and mix thoroughly.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5-15 min.
Place on magnet until clear and discard 175 μL of supernatant.
Add 200 μL of 80% ethanol, incubate on magnet for ≥ 30s, then repeat ethanol wash (200 μL, ≥ 30s).
Discard ethanol and dry beads at room temperature for 3-5 min.
Remove from magnet and resuspend beads in 50 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0 – 8.5).
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min to elute DNA (can be stored at 4°C for ≤24 hrs; do not freeze).

steps.title: Second Post-ligation Cleanup (0.7X)
steps.instruction: Combine 50 μL of beads with purified DNA from the previous step with 35 μL of PEG/NaCl Solution and mix thoroughly.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5-15 min.
Place on magnet until clear and discard 80 μL of supernatant.
Add 200 μL of 80% ethanol, incubate on magnet for ≥ 30s, then repeat ethanol wash (200 μL, ≥ 30s).
Discard ethanol and dry beads at room temperature for 3-5 min.
Remove from magnet and resuspend beads in 22 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0 – 8.5).
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min to elute DNA.
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 20 μL of supernatant to a new tube (store at 4°C for ≤1 week or -20°C for ≤1 month).

steps.title: Library Amplification
steps.instruction: Mix 20 μL of purified, adapter-ligated DNA with 30 μL of library amplification master mix (containing 27.5 µL KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix (2X) and 5.5 µL Library Amplification Primer Mix (10X) including excess).

substeps.instruction: Mix well by pipetting.

steps.title: Final Library Cleanup (1X)
steps.instruction: Combine 50 μL of amplified DNA with 50 μL of KAPA Pure Beads and mix thoroughly.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5-15 min.
Place on magnet until clear and discard 95 μL of supernatant.
Add 200 μL of 80% ethanol, incubate on magnet for ≥ 30s, and discard ethanol.
Dry beads at room temperature for 3-5 min.
Resuspend beads in 22 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0 – 8.5).
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min to elute DNA.
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 20 μL of supernatant to a new tube (store at 4°C for ≤ 1 week or -20°C).
